name: Rant
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30054.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Rant: The Iron Gate Guild is an excellent choice to safeguard your valuables, if I do say so myself. Our rates are reasonable and our reputation is spotless. Ask any of your friends!

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30054-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Rant: Ha ha! It's the jar I ordered from Giran. I was worried it would be broken during shipping. I'm so relieved! Ah, you need a receipt, don't you? Here it is. Let me just sign it and confirm delivery. There you go -- have a nice day!

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30054-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Rant: Please tell Mr. Arnold that I received it. And don't forget to show him the receipt I gave you!
